# Yardlet 0.11.7
## Security
- Keys and tokens that a web page shows, such as an API key on a service's settings page, are hidden from what the browser tools return to agents. Settings › General › Hide keys and tokens turns this off. - Reading files from a paired phone is more limited.
## Google
- Yardlet's own Google app now signs in for Gmail, Calendar and Drive only. Google Analytics and Google Ads need a Google OAuth app of your own: Settings › Connectors › Google › Use a Google OAuth app of your own… - An account that turned Analytics or Ads on with Yardlet's app keeps Gmail, Calendar and Drive as they are. Analytics and Ads show Needs sign-in until you save an app of your own and reconnect the account.
## New
- A task's terminal has tabs. + opens another shell in the task's folder, and a tab's menu renames, restarts or closes it. ⌃` shows and hides the terminal, as ⌘J does, and Run in terminal types only at a shell's prompt. - Antigravity CLI 1.4.11 and later runs over ACP, as the other ACP agents do, with its approval requests, Yardlet's tools and each turn's usage. - Import conversation… also lists OpenCode, Kimi Code, Grok Build and Hermes Agent conversations. - Kimi Code and Grok Build can keep extra accounts, and Settings › Accounts reads Muse Code's and Kimi Code's sign-ins. - A scheduled run starts on another account when its own has 10% or less of a limit left. - A Claude limit card offers Resume once its limit has reset. - Right-click a link in a conversation to open a task in a new tab, a split view or the side panel, a page in the task's browser or your default browser, or a file in Yardlet, its own app or Finder. - Personal agents: a dot that writes while you are elsewhere is marked unread and sends a notification, which Settings › Notifications › Personal agent messages turns off. Dot conversations show images and each message's time, a dot's details list the Codex tasks it started, and agents can read your dots. - The browser panel's bars, such as an agent's handoff, a permission question and the password manager's offers, sit above the page instead of over it. - A task's saved browser tabs load only when shown, as Chrome restores tabs. - The password manager offers to save a password sent from a dialog with no form, and the key button lists what the field takes, account first.
## Fixes
- Signing in to a site in one task no longer sets off a chain of cookie copies between tasks that could sign them out of accounts such as Google's. - Dragging the shown tab in the title bar moves the tab, not the window. - Going back to one of the last four tasks a window showed is quicker, a long turn opens with only the rows in view, and a streaming answer takes work only for the turn it changes. - Messages no longer stay in memory after they leave the screen on macOS 27. - Retry on an error card sends the retry message again instead of the button's words. - A single tilde, as in `240~400 ms`, is no longer drawn as strikethrough. - The composer grows once when a line wraps, without a flash of the scroller. - After a newer agent CLI is installed, scheduled tasks and work a quit cut off start the newer one. - A stopped turn's queue no longer stays paused over an empty list. - Antigravity sign-in reaches its browser step with the CLI details hidden.

# Yardlet 0.11.6
Yardlet starts on macOS 15 again. Since 0.11.0 it quit as soon as it opened there. If you are on macOS 15, download this version: the earlier ones cannot open to update themselves.
## New
- The browser panel saves and fills your addresses and payment cards. A card fills only after Touch ID, never with its security code, and never for an agent. - Sign-ins that ask for the username first keep it for the password step, and other fields such as an AWS account ID are saved with the item. The save bar closes with an X and says Save when it adds a username. - Move a task one level up or under another task in the sidebar, from its menu or by dragging it. - Personal agents: read a dot's activity records and reply in threads in Yardlet. - Settings says when Yardlet's instructions reach a task: when Yardlet starts or resumes it.
## Fixes
- Your own messages stay in view when a turn's work folds. - A Codex error shows once after Retry. - A subagent cut off by quitting tells the task that was waiting for it, and quitting to update waits for working subagents too. - Moving an account's tasks to another folder carries on after a quit. - A task cannot be archived while work it started is still running. - An agent CLI that stops reading no longer ends Yardlet, and a shell command is no longer cut short while Yardlet is busy. - Less work on the main thread while Codex streams, in tasks with many saved cards, and while subagents run. - A saved connector file that cannot be read is left as it is, and Settings says so, instead of being replaced. - The password the vault made is kept unless the page certainly did not take it.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.6.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.

# Yardlet 0.11.5
## New
- The built-in browser plays H.264 video and AAC audio, so MP4 video on sites such as X and LinkedIn plays as it does in Chrome. - Find and pick any saved password or code from the browser panel. Settings › Passwords and the key button's list search by name, username or site, and the key button shows on every site while the vault holds an item. - Two-factor codes: one-time code fields are found in more languages and sign-in steps. A code saved without a site is linked to its account's sign-in when nothing else could be meant, and the rest are listed in Settings › Passwords with a suggested site. - A blank browser tab shows a start page with the pages the task's tabs showed, as Safari, Chrome and the Codex app do, and the side panel's launcher offers them too. - Memory saver has Chrome's Moderate, Balanced and Maximum levels. A tab an agent opened that no panel showed is let go ten minutes after the agent's turn. - A Codex account's banked usage-limit resets show beside its limits and on its limit card, and one is used only after you confirm. - Before removing a saved Claude account, move its tasks to another folder of the same account. - A task started from another task nests under it in the sidebar, up to two levels. - Dots: send files and photos, see what a dot is working on, and answer its approvals, forms and option questions in Yardlet. Dot avatars animate, and moving between personal agents and tasks is quicker. - An agent can quote you by a phrase, and the message that holds it is passed on as you typed it.
## Fixes
- Long conversations and streaming Codex answers take much less work on the main thread, so scrolling and typing stay smooth with long histories, many saved cards and running subagents. - A Codex turn that failed on a busy server can be retried. - A Codex turn folds its work only once a final answer begins, as the Codex app does. - Agents get clearer failures from Yardlet's tools and the browser tools, with whether calling again can help.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.5.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Earlier versions update themselves. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.
